authorization: The user explicitly authorized this no-training successor to repair the direct-authority numerical validation contract, freeze a trustworthy clean single-P baseline, and execute the unchanged time-role mechanism stages only if that baseline passes.
question: Under one eager float32 32D clean-direct arithmetic authority and an analytically propagated external-error budget, why is clean single-P seed 3011 sensitive to removing normalized time: is its registered Ce deficit removable by one label-free margin scale, where does time enter the retained-time control, and do no-time networks express state-dependent plasticity beyond absolute support position?
claim_boundary: This successor repairs a numerical-validation and call-shape contract. It does not revise the frozen failure of single_p_time_role_direct_authority or the parent clean_single_p outcome time_removal_failure.

No model, checkpoint, input, seed, panel, endpoint, threshold, task stream, intervention, or Stage 1--3 scientific estimand changes. No training, optimization, model selection, or tolerance fitting is permitted.
The direct implementation is the sole internal-state authority. Historical adapter P, hidden state, eligibility, local state, and storage summaries are not internal references.
Analytic error bounds apply only to continuous descendants of margins. Ranking, masks, sampling selections, routes, decisions, and scientific classifications remain exact comparison gates.

A compatible baseline establishes numerical interpretability for this diagnostic, not success of seed 3011. Mechanism labels remain unassigned unless all registered mechanism stages execute without an integrity failure.
Any mechanism finding is restricted to the three frozen networks and is not a human or biological mechanism or a population-prevalence claim.

scientific_estimands.inherited: The canonical field, Stage 1--3 estimands, resampling, thresholds, labels, unconditional execution rule, and scientific claim boundaries are unchanged.

design.checkpoint_rule: Use exactly the checkpoint selected by the parent model lock for each seed, condition, and clean or noisy training arm.
design.input_rule: Use exactly the generic and Liu inputs selected by the parent repaired source lock for each panel and clean or noisy observation arm.
design.one_arithmetic_authority: Use the 32D clean-direct eager implementation for every recurrent update, support replay, query read, intervention, probe, field, and margin. Reuse of its already qualified equations is allowed only under a new content-addressed source lock.
design.no_training: Optimizer construction, gradients, parameter updates, checkpoint selection, and new training randomness are prohibited.

runtime.model_execution: CUDA eager float32 for every baseline, intervention, trajectory, probe, and query operation.
runtime.statistics: CPU float64 using the inherited estimators, exact masks and grouping, 2000-draw paired or clustered resampling, fixed seeds, and equal-panel aggregation.
runtime.determinism: Enable deterministic Torch algorithms, disable cuDNN benchmarking, use highest float32 matmul precision, set one Torch interop thread, one Torch intraop thread, and one BLAS/compiler thread, and record device and software identity.
runtime.same_process_replay: For every baseline unit, independently load immutable inputs and fresh execution state twice in one process. Every required direct raw array, full-batch terminal P, full-batch-sliced selected prefix P, field, and margin must match in dtype, shape, finite mask, and bytes.
runtime.failure: Any source, environment, determinism, shape, finite-mask, inventory, mutation, or registered numerical gate failure stops the applicable phase without mechanism interpretation.

batch_shape_contract.generic_support: Replay each frozen generic input file once at its complete 64-participant batch shape. Obtain selected Stage-3 trajectories only by slicing the stored full-batch prefix states; never re-run selected episodes as a two-participant support batch.
batch_shape_contract.liu_support: Replay the complete 77-participant Liu cohort for every original and support-schedule condition.
batch_shape_contract.query_conditions: Within each cohort, retain identical participant order and complete query layout across original, P-off, removal, shuffle, and query-time conditions. Query-time interventions clone the locked terminal P and do not write back.
batch_shape_contract.stage_3_natural: The two prospectively selected episodes per support length are read from full-batch-sliced prefix P. All natural prefix comparisons use their fixed two-participant order and identical read-call shapes.
batch_shape_contract.stage_3_probe: For every episode and prefix, construct the complete fixed 112-condition probe expansion. Compute a no-write control field and a post-probe field from identical expanded P, codes, participant order, query layout, and single-call batch shape. Susceptibility is the paired same-shape difference, never a comparison to a two-participant natural field.
batch_shape_contract.chunking: No semantic cohort or probe expansion may be split into result-dependent chunks. Each declared call group is executed in one call; its batch size, ordered identities, and tensor shapes are stored and verified.
batch_shape_contract.rationale: Mathematically equivalent batched and sliced operations are not assumed bitwise identical in finite precision. Batch shape is part of the frozen arithmetic path, not a scientific factor.

margin_gate.formula: For every finite reference margin M_i^R, b_i = 1e-5 + 1e-5 * abs(M_i^R), and abs(M_i^D - M_i^R) <= b_i.
margin_gate.metadata: Shapes, order, dtype class, and finite or missing masks must match exactly before values are compared.

same_input_reconstruction.rule: Recompute every saved parent probability and CE endpoint from the exact saved parent margins, signs, temperature, masks, grouping, and averaging order used by its source implementation.
same_input_reconstruction.purpose: This gate validates statistical definitions and metadata only; it is not applied across different direct and historical margins.

analytic_edges.probability: For p_i = sigmoid(y_i M_i / T), the propagated per-query budget is b_i / (4*T).
analytic_edges.cross_entropy: For ell_i = softplus(-y_i M_i / T), the propagated per-query budget is b_i / T.
analytic_edges.temperatures: Use T=1 for generic probability and CE. Use the frozen parent Liu temperature T=0.25 for Liu probability and CE; no value is inferred from a metric name.
analytic_edges.weighted_mean: For a fixed nonnegative normalized weight vector, the output budget is the same weighted sum of input budgets.
analytic_edges.linear_contrast: For sum_j c_j x_j, the output budget is sum_j abs(c_j) B_j. Paired differences sum both component budgets, and four-cell interactions sum all four coefficient-weighted budgets.
analytic_edges.equal_panel_mean: Use the arithmetic mean of the three panel budgets with the exact registered panel order.
analytic_edges.bootstrap: Regenerate the exact registered bootstrap count matrices. Each draw budget is the count-weighted participant budget divided by the fixed included count.
analytic_edges.quantile: Each corresponding interval endpoint may differ by at most the maximum propagated budget over its bootstrap draws, plus the registered implementation slack.

implementation_slack.rule: Add 1e-12 after each float64 nonlinear transform, reduction, linear contrast, bootstrap matrix product, panel mean, or quantile edge. Accumulate it additively along the explicit dependency graph; never replace a propagated input budget with this slack.
implementation_slack.qualification: Before scientific output exposure, compare each implemented edge on fixed synthetic finite fixtures against a higher-precision or independently evaluated reference and require maximum unexplained error <= 1e-13. The 1e-12 edge allowance is fixed prospectively and may not be fitted to parent or direct scientific results.

numerical_contract.continuous_gate: Every direct participant endpoint, registered paired effect, four-cell contrast, panel point, equal-panel point, bootstrap draw, and reported interval endpoint that descends continuously from margins must be within its computed element-specific or statistic-specific propagated budget. There is no separate fixed 1e-8 summary gate.
numerical_contract.discrete_gate: Finite and missing masks, learned masks, participant/query order, episode indices, selected episode identities and positions, evidence routes, internal order arrays, included-subject sets, and every parent competence, binding, core, compensation, Ce noninferiority, per-seed outcome, and overall outcome classification must match exactly. The overall outcome must remain time_removal_failure.
numerical_contract.rank_boundary: Kendall tau, order-shift, selection, threshold, and Boolean outputs are not admitted by a Lipschitz margin budget. Their discrete inputs must match exactly; same-input recomputation then uses the 1e-10 reconstruction gate or exact Boolean comparison.
numerical_contract.audit_artifact: Persist the complete named error-budget graph, observed errors, allowed budgets, masks, bootstrap identities, and pass flags in typed deterministic baseline artifacts and summarize maxima in the baseline result.

phase_1_propagated_baseline.scope: Execute all 72 seed-by-panel-by-condition-by-cell units before declaring compatibility. Mechanism estimators and interventions are not imported or executed.
external_outputs: all generic original-query margins, signs, learned masks, episode identities, probability and CE participant endpoints
all Liu intact, P-off, evidence-shuffle, and leave-one-relation-out margins and the endpoints, routes, and classifications derived from them
all panel points and bootstrap draws needed for competence, evidence binding, core, compensation, Ce five-endpoint noninferiority, per-seed decisions, and the overall outcome
internal_artifacts: full-batch terminal P and direct fields or margins for every Ce generic batch and Liu cohort in both architecture conditions
full-batch prefix trajectories plus selected slice identities for the fixed Ce Stage-3 generic episodes
direct fields or margins for A0, Ae, and C0 required by the Stage-1 secondary geometry
the batch-shape and call-group manifest and the complete propagated-error audit
phase_1_propagated_baseline.stage_3_selection: For each seed, panel, condition, and support length 28, 32, 36, or 40, select the two smallest frozen episode_indices before reading new results, exactly as in the predecessor protocol.
phase_1_propagated_baseline.artifact_format: Write deterministic typed NPZ members with allow_pickle=False semantics, stable logical identities, dtype and shape metadata, member SHA-256, and one aggregate manifest under the ignored runtime root.

baseline_incompatible: any gate fails; freeze the failure record, preserve all parent and predecessor records, execute no mechanism stage, and stop

a committed source, input, checkpoint, environment, and command lock for the baseline implementation
a committed all-unit baseline result containing every gate outcome and no mechanism estimate
a committed content-addressed lock covering every runtime baseline member and aggregate manifest

baseline_freeze.immutability: The mechanism phase verifies all committed locks before reading arrays. Missing, extra, changed, regenerated, or partially rewritten members are fatal. The baseline may not be rerun after its result is exposed in this study.
baseline_freeze.authorization_gate: Only baseline_compatible authorizes Phase 2. Compatibility alone assigns no mechanism label.

phase_2_mechanism.entry: Read locked baseline arrays only; do not regenerate original terminal P, prefix P, fields, or margins.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_1: Execute the inherited final-margin Hodge decomposition and positive scalar estimand. Fit one label-free positive scalar on panel-1 Ce generic plus Liu canonical fields per seed, test the five Ce endpoints on panels 2--3 with lower95 >= -0.02, and report mandatory A0, Ae, and C0 context.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_2: For Ce time-retained controls, replay reverse, deterministic deranged, and mean-clamped support schedules under the frozen full-cohort shapes and compare with locked originals. For query-time interventions, clone locked terminal P, change only query time, prohibit writeback, and execute full generic and Liu cohorts for all seeds and panels.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_3: For both Ce architectures, use locked full-batch-sliced P_0 through P_T for the fixed episodes, compute inherited prefix geometry and natural effective writes, and execute the exhaustive fixed pair-by-evidence probe battery with paired same-shape no-write controls. Probes never mutate locked or natural trajectories.
phase_2_mechanism.unconditional_rule: Once admitted, execute all inherited Stage 1--3 estimands for every registered seed and panel regardless of intermediate scientific values. Only an integrity failure may stop execution.
